verdict.rationale: Plausible documents scheduled email and Slack reports, which let a PM subscribe to the dashboard. It also documents traffic spike notifications, and its GitHub README adds traffic drop notifications, so abnormal movement in traffic triggers an alert. Missing for 10: alerting on metrics other than traffic (e.g. goals, revenue), documented threshold or anomaly-detection configuration, in-depth docs beyond one-line feature listings, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally

citations.quote: Traffic spike notifications: get alerted when traffic spikes
Email reports: scheduled reports delivered to your inbox
Slack reports: send reports to a Slack channel
Get weekly or monthly reports via email or Slack, including traffic spike/drop notifications.
